name: NuLat
summary: NuLat develops a compact fast-timing antineutrino detector based on a Raghavan optical lattice. Fine spatial segmentation is intended to reconstruct inverse-beta-decay topology, suppress backgrounds and support reactor-neutrino measurements.
detection_principle: Lithium-loaded scintillator cubes are separated by air gaps. Total internal reflection directs light along three orthogonal axes to photomultipliers, localizing energy deposits and the delayed lithium neutron-capture signal.
